scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c "uv sync --frozen && uv run python -m pytest"
scripts.test:frontend: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm --no-deps frontend sh -c "npm ci && npm test"
scripts.lint: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c "uv sync --frozen && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check ."
scripts.format: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c "uv sync --frozen && uv run ruff format ."
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm --no-deps frontend sh -c "npm ci && npm run typecheck"
scripts.db:revision: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm backend uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.db:downgrade: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm backend uv run alembic downgrade -1
scripts.db:current: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm backend uv run alembic current
scripts.db:history: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm backend uv run alembic history
scripts.db:check: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm backend uv run alembic check
scripts.db:psql: node scripts/compose.mjs exec postgres psql -U pivot -d pivot
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/compose.mjs down -v && node scripts/compose.mjs up -d --build --wait
